question: Migration 0083's campaigns_admin.item_id and qr_codes.item_id reference menu_items(id) with no ON DELETE clause, so an existing campaign referencing a dish makes the Inventory > Recipes > By dish MERGE fail with an opaque 500 (23503) permanently. Both pre-existing menu_items FKs (0061, 0062) are ON DELETE CASCADE. The 0083 DDL is verbatim from the signed handoff spec section 4, so every fix deviates from it somewhere. Which fix?
proposal: ON DELETE SET NULL on both 0083 FKs. A campaign must not be destroyed by a dish rename (rules out CASCADE), and a dish merge must not be blocked by a campaign (rules out the status quo). SET NULL degrades one UTM parameter and preserves both records; the spec's section 4 omitted the clause rather than choosing none, since it never considered the merge path.

question: As the operator grading P-KR3's orphan rate, I want the qr_scans count to be the number of real scans, so that the KR's denominator is not inflated by double-taps. G6 measured the 10-minute dedupe in landing.go:306-312 as a read-then-write INSERT ... SELECT ... WHERE NOT EXISTS under READ COMMITTED: 12 concurrent GET /q/{short} with one identical CF-Connecting-IP produced 8 qr_scans rows in 4 of 5 runs. The card enforces dedupe at write time only, so no read-side correction is available to the later reconciliation cards. Should the run make the dedupe atomic now, or leave it for triage?
proposal: Make it atomic now inside Card 1 via the bucket column plus unique index and ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. The dedupe window is explicitly the card's own to decide, so its correctness is the card's too; a KR denominator that silently inflates is worse than a column the spec did not enumerate, and an advisory lock puts a serialization point on an unauthenticated public route.

question: As the owner reading the Stats tab, I want each scan attributed to the campaign that earned it, so that spend per channel and per dish is a real number rather than one bucket labelled unattributed. Card 4 found that this cannot work on live data today: Card 3's mirror.go says H3b resolves campaign through code_id, but scan_attempts.code_id is the Supabase public.codes id (the per-customer redemption token, supabase/migrations/20260904000100_qr_attribution_spine.sql:45) and HQ Postgres holds no copy of that table. qr_codes is a different id space keyed by short. So nothing maps code_id to campaign_id, every accepted attempt falls to unattributed for campaign and direct for channel and item, and discount_unknown_rows becomes the whole set. Revenue and discount stay correct per row; only attribution dies. Card 4 shipped the COALESCE ladder so it starts working the instant either side is filled, and pinned the degraded shape as a test. How should attribution be closed?
proposal: Populate campaign_id in the mirror at write time. The resolution belongs where public.codes actually lives, it needs no new HQ table or second copy of customer tokens, and Card 4's ladder already consumes it the moment it appears. Tonight ships option 3's honest degradation as the interim, since the night cannot add a card.
